question:
There are 6 flats on a floor in two rows (three in each row opposite to each other). Flats of one row are facing north. Flats of other row are facing south. These flats are alloted to A, B, C, D, E and F. D and F get diagonally opposite flats. F's flat is next to C's flat. C gets a South facing flat. The direction in which the flats of B and E are facing is same. B's flat is not next to D.

Who gets a north-facing flat?
